options.content:
### Kubernetes Namespaces & Pods

**Did this board earn its place on your screen?** A rating on [its grafana.com page](https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/25799/) takes two clicks and is the only thing that helps the next person find it. A [star on the repo](https://github.com/Fractal-Techware/grafana-dashboards?utm_source=grafana-com&utm_medium=dashboard-panel&utm_campaign=k8s-ns-pods) does the same on GitHub.

Free and MIT-licensed, from Fractal Techware. The source, a Docker Compose demo stack that generates sample data, and the other free boards: [github.com/Fractal-Techware/grafana-dashboards](https://github.com/Fractal-Techware/grafana-dashboards?utm_source=grafana-com&utm_medium=dashboard-panel&utm_campaign=k8s-ns-pods).

**Our other free dashboards on grafana.com.** Dashboards → New → Import, paste the ID:

- `25798` — **Infrastructure Overview**, Linux host health (node_exporter)
- `25835` — **VPS Host (node_exporter)**, one server in depth, incl. OOM kills and inodes
- `25836` — **n8n Production Overview**, n8n in queue mode: workers, backlog, failures

**When one of these panels goes red**, there is a free runbook for each of 165 Prometheus alerts — what it means, what it breaks and the commands to diagnose it: [fractaltechware.com/runbooks](https://fractaltechware.com/runbooks?utm_source=grafana-com&utm_medium=dashboard-panel&utm_campaign=k8s-ns-pods).

Need more than this? The paid pack adds the rest of the Kubernetes set — cluster overview, nodes, workloads and a container runtime deep dive — and, across its tiers, application RED metrics, blackbox endpoints, Loki logs, capacity planning, alert operations, Prometheus and Grafana alert rules, and Terraform and Helm provisioning: [Grafana Observability Dashboard Pack](https://store.fractaltechware.com/l/grafana-dashboard-pack?utm_source=grafana-com&utm_medium=dashboard-panel&utm_campaign=k8s-ns-pods).

spec.title: Memory by Namespace
spec.description: Sum of container memory working set per namespace (cAdvisor).

spec.title: Top CPU Pods
spec.description: The 15 pods with the highest CPU usage (cAdvisor).

spec.expr: topk(15, sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Top Memory Pods
spec.description: The 15 pods with the highest memory working set (cAdvisor).

spec.expr: topk(15, sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!="POD"}))

spec.title: Pod Restart Trend
spec.description: The 15 pods with the most container restarts per dashboard interval (kube-state-metrics).

spec.title: Pending Pods
spec.description: Pods stuck in the Pending phase (unschedulable or pulling images). Requires kube-state-metrics.

spec.description: Pods in the Failed phase. Requires kube-state-metrics.
